stories.title: Egypt authorizes military support for Saudi Arabia against Houthis
stories.summary: Egypt parliament voted Monday to let President el-Sissi send defensive military aid, including air defenses, to Saudi Arabia amid intensifying Houthi attacks. The move edges Egypt closer to involvement in the Gulf conflict.

stories.title: UN panel: Russia committing crimes against humanity in Ukraine
stories.summary: An independent UN investigation panel found Russian authorities committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by systematically attacking civilian energy infrastructure in Ukraine. The report strengthens the legal case against Moscow.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi acquitted in 2018 defamation case
stories.summary: An Indian court acquitted Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in a 2018 defamation case over remarks against Amit Shah. The ruling clears a legal hurdle for the opposition leader.

stories.title: Lula da Silva wins historic fourth term as Brazil president
stories.summary: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva defeated far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff to claim a fourth, nonconsecutive term, the first candidate since 1989 to win the final round after losing the first. The result reshapes the political landscape of South America.

stories.title: Anthropic files S-1, disclosing 16.3 billion dollars in first-half revenue
stories.summary: Anthropic, maker of Claude, filed its IPO prospectus revealing 16.3 billion dollars in revenue through the first half of 2026 versus 4.6 billion dollars in all of 2025. The filing positions it to become the first frontier AI lab to go public.

stories.title: Meta to raise up to 95 billion dollars to fund AI expansion
stories.summary: Meta announced a two-part fundraising drive of up to 95 billion dollars, including 35 billion dollars in new stock, to pay for AI infrastructure and its push toward personal superintelligence. The raise underscores the scale of capital frontier AI now demands.

stories.title: Browns rally past Titans 27-24 on last-second field goal, improve to 5-2
stories.summary: Andre Szmyt kicked a 32-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Browns over Tennessee, their NFL-high fifth game-winning drive of the season. Cleveland improves to 5-2 and stays atop the AFC North.

stories.title: Victory Monday: Concepcion, Watson shine as Browns turn to Steelers
stories.summary: Rookie KC Concepcion posted a career-high 152 scrimmage yards and Deshaun Watson threw for 308 yards in the Week 7 win, with a defensive starter reportedly extended overnight. Cleveland next visits Pittsburgh, where it has not won a regular-season game since 2003.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Oregon set for 3:30 p.m. ET on CBS for Scarlet the Shoe
stories.summary: The No. 2 Buckeyes Nov. 7 home game against Oregon will kick off at 3:30 p.m. ET on CBS as the annual Scarlet the Shoe game. Ohio State is coming off its bye week.

stories.title: Ohio State soccer claims first outright Big Ten title since 2017
stories.summary: The third-ranked Buckeyes beat Illinois 3-0 to secure their first outright Big Ten regular-season championship in nearly a decade and the No. 1 seed in the conference tournament.

stories.title: Ohio State basketball beats Butler 82-73; Thad Matta honored
stories.summary: Amare Bynum scored 23 points as the Buckeyes closed the preseason with an 82-73 exhibition win over Butler, with former coach Thad Matta honored at halftime. OSU opens the regular season Nov. 2 against BYU.

stories.title: Ferrari drivers deliver disappointing verdict on US GP upgrade
stories.summary: Ferrari drivers gave a downbeat assessment of a much-anticipated United States GP upgrade package after early running at Austin.

stories.title: Leclerc addresses potential race absence ahead of birth of his first child
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc addressed the possibility of missing a Formula 1 race with the birth of his first child approaching.

stories.title: Leclerc pips Verstappen to top FP1 at United States GP
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc set the fastest time in opening practice at Circuit of the Americas, edging Max Verstappen for an early boost to the Ferrari weekend in Austin.

stories.title: Norris says McLaren car is one of the hardest he has driven
stories.summary: Lando Norris issued a blunt warning to McLaren, calling his current car one of the hardest he has ever driven as F1 arrives at the United States Grand Prix.

stories.title: Columbus man sentenced to 36-40 years for shooting at four police officers
stories.summary: A 19-year-old Columbus man was sentenced to 36 to 40 years in prison after pleading guilty to firing at four Columbus police officers as a teen, a case that drew emotional moments in court.

stories.title: Murder charge to be added against North Linden man after girlfriend dies
stories.summary: Columbus police plan to add a murder charge against a North Linden man after his girlfriend died weeks after a September assault, with a coroner ruling her death a homicide.

stories.title: Forgent selects downtown Columbus for expansion, adding 85 jobs
stories.summary: Forgent Power Solutions, a maker of electrical distribution equipment for data centers and the grid, will expand its downtown Columbus office, creating 85 jobs and 12 million dollars in annual payroll.
